summary: This clinical trial is testing a combination of the study drug CS0159 and Semaglutide in patients who have obesity, type 2 diabetes, and a liver condition known as metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease. The study plans to enroll 30 participants who are between the ages of 18 and 65 years. The trial status is currently listed as not yet recruiting.
